title: The Geography
note: Yuki's interior of Mnehmos's descent + address. She counts the seven steps as traveled-by-him this time. The architecture clicks into language as Mnehmos names Sebastopyr / Cathedral Sebastinum / Vas Halidani. Her name lands fourth as 'a point set in the grid.' Accepts the dry wrap; removes wet outer layer; cold-load mitigates honestly. Her second spoken line: 'I'll take them.'

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: The understanding that lets our speech meet is provisional. It will hold until the third day at evening.
